versions.changelog: Replace risky plugin metadata with an English documentation-only skill so the package can clear security scanning.
Revert to version 1.0.0 to match GitHub release version. Added SECURITY.md for VirusTotal false positive explanation.

ai-testcase-generator-pro v2.3.0

- Major refactor: migrated from implementation and development files to a streamlined, documentation-focused skill package.
- All source code and configuration files removed, leaving only metadata and comprehensive usage documentation.
- New SKILL.md offers concise skill summary, usage scenarios, parameters, output description, scoring breakdown, and examples.
- Documentation now emphasizes invocation guidance and review loop process for end users.

**Major documentation overhaul for setup, usage, and configuration**

- Expanded and reorganized SKILL.md with clear step-by-step installation, setup, and usage instructions for OpenClaw users.
- Added detailed configuration examples, environment variables, and supported AI provider references.
- Clarified all input methods (chat commands, file upload, tool invocation) and advanced usage options.
- Included persona review process, output formats, contribution guidelines, and support links.
- No changes to skill functionality or code—documentation update only.

Version 2.1.0

- Updated review loop logic in skill prompts (prompts.ts).
- SKILL.md documentation refreshed; no parameter or usage changes.
- Improved scoring and review persona descriptions for better clarity.

- Updated the OpenClaw environment variable requirement from multiple API keys to only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
- Removed support for specifying alternate AI providers in the environment setup.
- No user-facing feature changes; all modifications are in skill metadata configuration.

- Updated required environment variable from individual API keys to a unified AI_PROVIDER.
- Adjusted metadata to reflect the new environment variable requirement.
- No changes to user-facing features or functionality.

Version 2.0.1

- Added MIT license and category metadata to SKILL.md.
- Expanded environment variable requirements to include provider-specific API keys.
- Updated metadata to specify safety level, manual audit, and safer API usage notes.
- Enhanced tags for better discoverability.
- General metadata structure improved for compatibility and clarity.

AI Test Case Generator Pro 2.0.0 features major improvements focusing on multi-format support and automated quality review.

- Introduces multi-model review with Test Manager, Dev Manager, and Product Manager personas.
- Supports generating test cases from PDFs, Word documents, images, video, and plain text.
- Exports results to Excel, Markdown, and XMind formats.
- Implements a review loop ensuring test case quality ≥ 90/100, with reviewer comments and scoring across multiple dimensions.
- Enhanced parameter options for targeted test case generation and language support (English, Chinese).
